title: Project 5 · TCP Chat Server + Client
summary: Tokio multi-client chat with bounded tasks, validated input and graceful shutdown.
requirements: tokio::net TcpListener accepting N clients, each a spawned task
Broadcast via mpsc: every message reaches other clients
Input validation: max 512 bytes/message; strip control characters
Cancellation: server shutdown signal drains clients cleanly (no unwrap on IO)

milestones.title: Echo baseline
milestones.detail: Single client read→write loop with timeout.

milestones.title: Shared broadcast hub
milestones.detail: Arc<Mutex<Vec<Sender>>> or mpsc fan-out; choose and justify.

milestones.title: Hardening
milestones.detail: Length caps, control-char filter, per-connection timeout.

milestones.title: Shutdown choreography
milestones.detail: Ctrl-C → notify all → join tasks → exit 0.

starterFiles.name: validate.rs

hints: tokio::select! over socket.read and shutdown channel gives clean exits.
Never unwrap on read/write — peer disconnects are normal.
completionCriteria: Two telnet clients chat in both directions
Oversize/hostile payloads rejected with error frames
Server exits with zero leaked tasks (join completes)
